---
id: env.cond.individual-treatment
type: condition
heading: Individual Treatment of Insureds
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Each insured is treated as having a separate policy for every provision of this policy that depends on what an insured knew, intended, did or failed to do, including [[ref:env.cond.your-duty-of-disclosure]], [[ref:env.excl.deliberate-non-compliance]] and [[ref:env.excl.known-conditions]].

The knowledge, conduct or failure of one insured is not imputed to any other insured. The one exception is that the knowledge or conduct of a member of the control group of an entity is imputed to that entity. Including more than one insured does not increase the limit of liability.
